lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca4Mg2Ti2O10 (reduced formula Ca2MgTiO5) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ti centers coordinated by six O neighbors and tetrahedral Mg centers coordinated by four O neighbors, while Ca adopts 8-vertex coordination polyhedra. The TiO6 octahedra share corners with one another and with the Mg tetrahedra, and the Ca polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces with Ti octahedra, forming a 3-periodic connected network.
